arguments.message: When you downgrade, Meridian doesn’t delete any data. Anything tied to a higher‑tier feature is simply hidden – you lose access to the feature, but the underlying records stay in the workspace and will reappear automatically if you upgrade again. The only caveat is that if the lower tier has a shorter retention window, records older than that window will eventually age out just as they would for a workspace that started on that tier.
